info.description:
IBAN is a payments service which is provided through one of Monavate’s banking partners. A Company Account will be allocated under which Virtual Accounts can be opened on behalf of Customers. Information must be provided on Customers to enable the bank to undertake background checks.

The IBAN API services allows the creation and management of Virtual Accounts, and to retrieve statements, balances and information about Company and Virtual Accounts.

The Payments services enables the movement of funds. This can be an internal transfer between Virtual Accounts, or a payment to an external bank account.

The Transaction service is used to retrieve details about transfers and payments.

Modifies existing data for one Virtual Account. For this service a background check of the Customer must be completed by the bank.

This service should not be used to allocate the IBAN to a different entity. Name changes are only allowed in case of legal change such as marriage, or corporate name change. Documentary evidence may be requested by the bank to support the changes.

post.description:
This request message is used to initiate an internal payment between IBANs or a payment to an external bank account.

Supported payment types:

- SEPA: SEPA payments are supported for EUR-EUR transfers within the Eurozone area. Transfers initiated before 16.30 (EET) typically credit the beneficiary the same day. Transfers initiated after this time credit the next working day. NOTE: SEPA Payments are only supported on ‘EE’ issued IBANS.

- SEPA INSTANT: SEPA INSTANT payments are supported for EUR-EUR transfers within the Eurozone area. Subject to sending and receiving banks checks, transfers are credited in seconds. NOTE: SEPA INSTANT Payments are only supported on ‘EE’ issued IBANS.

- Faster Payments: The Faster Payment method can be used for GBP – GBP transfers between UK bank, transfers typically credit the beneficiary within 2 hours of initiation. NOTE: Faster Payments are only supported on ‘GB’ issued IBANS.

- SWIFT: SWIFT payments (often referred to as International Payments) can be used for any transfers falling outside of the above-mentioned payment types. Transfers typically credit the beneficiary within 2-3 business days of sending. NOTE: SWIFT Payments are only supported on ‘EE’ issued IBANS.

parameters.description:
Status of the account. Possible values are:
-OPENING - transition status displayed upon user opening an account which updates to ACTIVE once the account is opened;
-CLOSING - transition status displayed upon user closing an account which updates to CLOSED - once the account is closed;
-MODIFYING - transition status displayed upon user modifying an account which updates to either ERROR, if modifications were not processed correctly, or ACTIVE once the account is active after modifications;
-PENDING - used temporarily for nameless virtual IBANs until personal details of the IBAN owner are added via Modify IBAN service; payments cannot be made from the account while in that status;
-ON_HOLD - used while background check is done by the bank for the IBAN owner until a decision is made; this status updates to ACTIVE or REJECTED if the request to create IBAN is denied;
-BLOCKED - set for blocked IBANs;
parameters.name: status
